attributes.title: [Metrics Aerospike] Overview
attributes.description: Aerospike cluster overview with node health and performance metrics using ES|QL

params.markdown:
**Note:** This dashboard uses ES|QL queries with the `TS` (time series) command for optimized time series analysis.
The `TS` command provides native rate calculations via `RATE()` and efficient time bucketing via `TBUCKET()`.

query.esql:
FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.node.name)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.node.name)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS namespace_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.namespace)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS namespace_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.namespace)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS total_connections = MAX(aerospike.node.connection.open)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS total_connections = MAX(aerospike.node.connection.open)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free)

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free), connections = SUM(aerospike.node.connection.open), namespaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.namespace) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| KEEP node, namespaces, memory_free, connections
| SORT node ASC
| LIMIT 100

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free), connections = SUM(aerospike.node.connection.open), namespaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(aerospike.namespace) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| KEEP node, namespaces, memory_free, connections
| SORT node ASC
| LIMIT 100

TS metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(aerospike.node.memory.free)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute), node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(aerospike.node.memory.free)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute), node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS connections = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(aerospike.node.connection.open)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute), node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS connections = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(aerospike.node.connection.open)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute), node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT memory_free DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.memory.free IS NOT NULL
| STATS memory_free = AVG(aerospike.node.memory.free) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT memory_free DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS connections = SUM(aerospike.node.connection.open) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT connections DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "aerospikereceiver.otel"
| WHERE aerospike.node.connection.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS connections = SUM(aerospike.node.connection.open) BY node = aerospike.node.name
| SORT connections DESC
| LIMIT 20
